title: Spin(2,3) programme end-to-end closure manifest
terminal_requirement: A source-derived, gauge-invariant, normalized and causal action must pass every upstream gate and produce at least one dimensionally normalized observable not inherited from generic Gaussian, Schur, symmetry or response theory.

status_vocabulary.established: The stated mathematical or physical bridge is proved at the declared type and scope.
status_vocabulary.conditional: The bridge is exact after an input not yet derived by the programme is supplied.
status_vocabulary.underdetermined: Several inequivalent choices survive all current constraints.
status_vocabulary.obstructed: An exact counterexample or type/no-go theorem closes the proposed direct route.
status_vocabulary.missing: No construction at the required type currently exists.

gates.name: Chiral Standard-Model matter carrier
gates.required_output: A mirror-free, anomaly-consistent, chirally typed Standard-Model/Furey matter module with Yukawa incidence.

gates.name: Gauge-invariant physical source selection
gates.required_output: A unique or dynamically selected pair of gauge-invariant Standard-Model composite probes with declared Lorentz type and non-redundant rank-two response support.
gates.first_missing_datum: Incidence and B-L define a canonical candidate source plane in the completed branch, but Ward protection leaves a scale-times-shear affine frame torsor; no renormalization condition or operational coupling selects one calibrated basis.

gates.name: Microscopic or controlled effective action
gates.required_output: One gauge-invariant local or controlled boundary action whose fields and couplings generate the selected probes and their response without fitted carrier matrices.
gates.qualification: Established as a nondynamical external-source generating functional conditional on a frame in the G01 source plane; it does not fix finite operator mixing, contacts or the real slice.

gates.name: Ward quotient and causal/KMS closure
gates.required_output: A Ward-legal physical quotient with positive spectral measure, analytic Herglotz response and controlled KMS sewing.
gates.first_missing_datum: Vacuum locality, Hermiticity and Lorentz covariance close the transverse two-current spectral measure on Sym2(R)+, with B-L Ward-protected only before Majorana breaking; the remaining datum is a renormalized subtraction/contact prescription and, for thermal claims, an explicit KMS tensor decomposition in the chosen source frame.
gates.qualification: The zero-temperature vacuum spectral measure and its subtracted Herglotz transform are established for the local Hermitian source pair. Full finite-temperature/KMS closure and the scheme-dependent polynomial part remain conditional.

gates.name: Positive H2(R) carrier closure
gates.required_output: A full-rank reciprocal two-channel response closing on the positive H2(R) cone across the relevant kinematic range.
gates.qualification: Established by both a generic source-current route and a separately typed topology-face route. The two copies of H2(R)+ have no established physical intertwiner and must not be identified merely because their cones are isomorphic.

gates.name: Physical two-face and real-slice selector
gates.required_output: One source-derived completely positive selector choosing the physical rank-two face and real link line without erasing that face or introducing an independent conjugation.
gates.first_missing_datum: Peirce, exchange and Clifford selectors exist, but require separately typed stages; Furey SU(3) and conjugation still leave two axes and positivity chooses neither.

gates.name: Source/dual typing, UV scale and contact normalization
gates.required_output: A source/response or stiffness/covariance dictionary with fixed units, subtraction tensor and dynamical bracket scale derived from the same action.
gates.first_missing_datum: For the declared integer currents the free three-generation UV cut fixes the nonlocal metric G/(8 pi^2) and an orthogonal shear convention, but it does not select the physical coupling or finite contact tensor; Jordan-Lie compatibility and positivity also do not calibrate the dynamical bracket.

gates.name: Physical orientation selection
gates.required_output: An action or boundary condition selecting one member of the source-to-flux orientation torsor and retaining a measurable orientation-odd coherence.
gates.first_missing_datum: A normalized ±1 index and positive interferometric witnesses exist, but flux reversal exchanges the two choices and no source-derived action chooses one.

gates.name: Algebraic completion and parent comparison
gates.required_output: An explicit invariant-preserving intertwiner showing that an enlarged Lie, Jordan, Freudenthal, Kantor or structurable object constrains the selected physical action or observable.
gates.first_missing_datum: The tested enlargements reproduce or regrade known structures but fail selection, CP covariance, grading compatibility or physical pairing; no E7/E8 parent is selected.
gates.qualification: The established H2(R) Jordan-to-TKK bridge remains exact; the obstruction concerns promotion to a more fundamental selecting parent.

gates.name: Pole, residue and scattering realization
gates.required_output: A physical channel dictionary carrying the normalized response into poles, positive residues and an on-shell scattering observable.
gates.first_missing_datum: Every finite rational positive response has a passive realization, but current residues are relational superpositions rather than uniquely Furey-typed Standard-Model thresholds.

gates.name: Dimensionally normalized novel observable
gates.required_output: At least one experimentally interpretable, dimensionally normalized relation whose value is fixed by the programme and is not a generic response identity.
gates.first_missing_datum: The ±1 orientation index, reciprocal delay-residue law and CP scores are exact after choosing a source map or generic response normalization, but the programme does not derive the physical map or a new Standard-Model value.

gates.name: End-to-end Standard-Model consistency
gates.required_output: One common construction passing anomaly, chirality, positivity, locality, unitarity, renormalization, identifiability and known-data checks.
gates.first_missing_datum: No single action currently joins the established matter module to the selected, normalized and oriented response and its observable readout.

smallest_resolving_tests.test: Compute, from one explicitly renormalized Standard-Model composite source pair, the full 2x2 retarded correlator including Ward completion, subtraction tensor and spectral density.
Derive from the same microscopic boundary action a real-slice selector and an orientation-odd phase, then show reversal changes the measured balanced interferometer output.
Calibrate the UV slope and contact tensor from a sum rule or measured asymptotic response, then test the predicted pole residues without refitting.

Pre-register one source-resolved scattering or stress/current observable whose numerical value differs from generic passive two-port theory and compare it with data or a first-principles Standard-Model calculation.
